name: four_a
intro: A four-stage security lock. Clear all four modules to escape.
manual:
PANEL MANUAL

MODULE 1 - WIRES
Cut exactly one wire:
- If the first wire is black, cut the LAST wire.
- If there is a white wire, cut the WHITE wire.
- Otherwise, cut the FIRST wire.

MODULE 2 - BUTTON
- If the word is HOLD, PRESS the button.
- If the button is blue, HOLD the button.
- Otherwise, PRESS the button.

MODULE 3 - KEYPAD
One symbol glows. Enter its code:
- spiral: 1212
- wave: 3434
- bolt: 5656

MODULE 4 - LEVERS
Three levers (top, middle, bottom), each UP or DOWN:
- If the top lever is UP, pull the BOTTOM lever.
- Otherwise, pull the TOP lever.

modules.title: A bundle of wires
modules.observation: Four wires, left to right: red, white, blue, green.

modules.title: A single button
modules.observation: A GREEN button showing the word WAIT.

modules.title: A symbol keypad
modules.observation: A keypad with a glowing BOLT symbol above it.

modules.title: Three levers
modules.observation: The TOP lever is DOWN, the MIDDLE lever is UP, the BOTTOM lever is DOWN.
